newsitem.title: UK: Granada weakens on hotel sale worries.
newsitem.headline: Granada weakens on hotel sale worries.

text.p: Shares in leisure and media company Granada Group dropped in a firm market on Monday on uncertainty about plans to dispose of its hotels.
Granada shares were down seven pence at 875p by 1226 GMT with over 1.4 million shares traded.
"There's a lot of worry about whether Granada will be able to get a good price for the hotels...The stocks have had a good run so we've seen some profit-taking," one market maker said.
The Financial Times newspaper quoted analysts as saying Granada might be hard-pressed to reach its target price for the flagship Grosvenor House Hotel in London.
The newspaper said Granada needs to realise 801 million pounds from the sale of its top hotels.
